안녕하세요, 가상상사 IT팀입니다.
SharePoint 커넥터 연결을 마치려고 Microsoft 계정으로 로그인했는데 'Need admin approval' 화면이 뜨고 더 진행되지 않습니다. 저는 앱 등록 담당자이지만 전역 관리자 계정은 아닙니다. 데이터 스토어를 지우고 다시 만들어도 같은 화면이 나옵니다. 어떻게 해야 연결을 끝낼 수 있을까요?

IT팀 드림
answer:
Entra 앱에 테넌트 전체 관리자 동의가 부여되지 않아 'Need admin approval' 화면이 표시됩니다(테넌트 상태 admin_consent: false). 전역 관리자 또는 클라우드 애플리케이션 관리자가 Entra 관리 센터에서 앱에 테넌트 전체 관리자 동의를 부여해야 합니다.
조치 순서:
1. 전역 관리자 또는 클라우드 애플리케이션 관리자 역할을 가진 Entra ID 관리자에게 동의 부여를 요청한다
2. 해당 관리자가 Gemini Enterprise 웹앱에서 SharePoint 연결을 시도하고, 권한 화면에서 'Consent on behalf of your organization'을 체크한 후 Accept를 클릭한다
3. 동의 부여 후 일반 사용자 계정으로 다시 연결을 시도하여 승인 화면 없이 진행되는지 확인한다
이 조치(grant_admin_consent)는 관리자가 승인(approve)한 뒤에만 적용됩니다.

[ge-sp-config#18] Microsoft SharePoint configuration - Users see "Need admin approval" when they connect (Gemini Enterprise 공식 문서, CC BY 4.0, 수집 기준일 2026-11-25)
### Users see "Need admin approval" when they connect

When users connect to Microsoft SharePoint from the Gemini Enterprise web
app for the first time, Microsoft might show a Need admin approval
screen. This happens if Gemini Enterprise requests administrator-level
permissions, or if your Microsoft Entra tenant prohibits users from authorizing
third-party apps without prior tenant-wide administrator consent.

To resolve this issue, an administrator must complete the first authorization.
After that, other users in your tenant can connect without the approval screen.

-
Ask a Microsoft Entra ID administrator who can grant tenant-wide consent to
sign in to the Gemini Enterprise web app and connect to
Microsoft SharePoint.

-
On the permissions screen, have the administrator select Consent on behalf
of your organization, and then click Accept.

-
Ask users to connect again.

For more information, see
Grant tenant-wide admin consent
in the Microsoft Entra documentation.

Note: Deleting and re-creating the data store doesn't resolve this issue,
because consent is granted in your Microsoft Entra tenant, not to the data store.

[ge-sp-config#02] Microsoft SharePoint configuration - Set up authentication and permissions (Gemini Enterprise 공식 문서, CC BY 4.0, 수집 기준일 2026-11-25)

Grant tenant-wide administrator consent to an
application in the Microsoft Entra documentation.

Caution:

- Tenant-wide administrator consent (CRITICAL): You must grant tenant-wide administrator consent in Microsoft Entra ID for the registered application. Lack of administrator consent is a common failure point that prevents the connector from authenticating.

- Dual App IDs: Note that Gemini Enterprise uses different Microsoft Entra App IDs for different features. You need one App ID for the backend 'Data store' connection and a separate App ID to enable the 'Upload from OneDrive/SharePoint' button in the chat interface. Both applications require administrator consent.

You can configure the following filters within the `params` object of your data connector:

Microsoft SharePoint data store.

- Exclusion filter (`admin_exclusion_filter`): Excludes specific information from the Microsoft SharePoint

[ge-idp#24] Configure identity provider - Impact of a subject value change (Gemini Enterprise 공식 문서, CC BY 4.0, 수집 기준일 2026-11-25)
### Impact of a subject value change

If the value that's mapped to `google.subject` changes for a user, then
Gemini Enterprise treats the user as a new user. For example, this happens
when the user's user principal name (UPN) or email address changes in Microsoft
Entra ID and your attribute mapping uses that attribute. Principal identifiers
are case-sensitive, so a change in letter case is also a change.

After the change, the following applies:

- The user can't access the chat history, notebooks, or agents that are
associated with the previous principal identifier.

- Gemini Enterprise doesn't migrate data from the previous principal
identifier to the new principal identifier.

- Licenses and IAM roles that are granted to the previous
principal identifier don't apply to the new principal identifier.

[ge-idp#25] Configure identity provider - Prepare for a subject value change (Gemini Enterprise 공식 문서, CC BY 4.0, 수집 기준일 2026-11-25)
### Prepare for a subject value change

To reduce the impact of a subject value change, do the following:

- Before you change a user's UPN or email address in your identity provider,
inform the user and ask them to
share any private agents or notebooks that
they want to keep.

- Assign a Gemini Enterprise license to the new principal identifier, and
grant the required roles to it. For more information, see
Grant permissions to users.

- Transfer ownership of the agents
that the user shared with others to the new principal identifier. You can't
transfer ownership of agents that aren't shared.

Gemini Enterprise associates a user's chat history, notebooks, and the
agents that the user creates with the user's principal identifier. If you use
Workforce Identity Federation, the principal identifier includes the value that your
attribute mapping assigns to `google.subject`. For example:

`principal://iam.googleapis.com/locations/global/workforcePools/POOL_ID/subject/SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE`

[ge-sp-overview#12] Overview - Troubleshooting SharePoint connector search results (Gemini Enterprise 공식 문서, CC BY 4.0, 수집 기준일 2026-11-25)
## Troubleshooting SharePoint connector search results

If you are experiencing issues with missing documents, incorrect results, or poor search relevance, check the following diagnostic areas:

- Check the People data store: Ensure the People search data store is set up and syncing if you face relevance or entity-matching issues.

- Authentication errors: Persistent authentication errors, such as "Error when retrieving Graph API access token," will prevent searches from functioning. To resolve this, check the Microsoft Entra ID logs for details and then re-authenticate the connection.

- Identity mismatch (data ingestion mode): When using data ingestion mode
with Google Identity, verify that each user's Google email address matches
their Microsoft email address. Mismatches prevent Gemini Enterprise
from returning search results.

- Targeted folder searches (.aspx URLs): Searching with full browser URLs that end in `/Forms/AllItems.aspx` executes a search across the whole site, not just the specific folder. Always use absolute folder paths for targeted searches.

[ge-sp-overview#05] Overview - Required permissions (Gemini Enterprise 공식 문서, CC BY 4.0, 수집 기준일 2026-11-25)
### Required permissions

To enable Gemini Enterprise to perform search and data ingestion using the Microsoft SharePoint data store, you need the following permissions:

#### Microsoft Graph API permissions

The table below outlines the permissions required for each connection mode.

Note: The following table outlines the permissions required for each connection mode. If you enable Actions for either the Federated search or Data ingestion connection mode, also select the permissions listed in the Actions row.

| Connection mode
| Scope
| Purpose

| Federated search
| N/A
| No Graph API permissions are required.

| Data ingestion
| `GroupMember.Read.All`
| (Federated credentials & OAuth 2.0 refresh token) Allows the data store to read memberships and basic group properties for all groups without a signed-in user.

| `User.Read`
| (Federated credentials & OAuth 2.0 refresh token) Allows the data store to read the profile of signed-in users. It also allows the data store to read basic company information of signed-in users.

[ge-idp#24] Configure identity provider - Impact of a subject value change (Gemini Enterprise 공식 문서, CC BY 4.0, 수집 기준일 2026-11-25)
### Impact of a subject value change

If the value that's mapped to `google.subject` changes for a user, then
Gemini Enterprise treats the user as a new user. For example, this happens
when the user's user principal name (UPN) or email address changes in Microsoft
Entra ID and your attribute mapping uses that attribute. Principal identifiers
are case-sensitive, so a change in letter case is also a change.

After the change, the following applies:

- The user can't access the chat history, notebooks, or agents that are
associated with the previous principal identifier.

- Gemini Enterprise doesn't migrate data from the previous principal
identifier to the new principal identifier.

- Licenses and IAM roles that are granted to the previous
principal identifier don't apply to the new principal identifier.

[ge-idp#11] Configure identity provider - Configure Workforce Identity Federation (Gemini Enterprise 공식 문서, CC BY 4.0, 수집 기준일 2026-11-25)
- Configure Workforce Identity Federation with an identity provider (IdP) that supports OIDC or SAML 2.0

#### Configure attribute mapping

Attribute mapping helps you connect your third-party identity information with
Google using Workforce Identity Federation.

When configuring attribute mapping in Workforce Identity Federation, consider the
following:

-
The `google.subject` attribute is used for attribute mapping, license
assignment, and sharing notebooks. We recommend mapping
`google.subject` to the user's email address in lowercase, as license
assignment is case sensitive. Don't map `google.subject` to the Microsoft
Entra ID object ID (GUID), which causes `403` sign-in errors and duplicate
license consumption when licenses are pre-assigned by email.

-
For Microsoft Entra ID, tokens omit group IDs when a user belongs to more
than 150 groups (SAML) or 200 groups (OIDC). To prevent
`403 Permission Denied` errors, restrict Microsoft Entra ID group claims to
Groups assigned to the application or apply a group filter.

[ge-idp#12] Configure identity provider - Configure Workforce Identity Federation (Gemini Enterprise 공식 문서, CC BY 4.0, 수집 기준일 2026-11-25)
-
If your organization has more than one unique identifier, map these unique
organizational attributes using the
`attribute.as_user_identifier_number between 1 and 50`
attribute.

For example, if your organization uses both email and principal name
as user identifiers across different applications, and the principal name is
set as the `preferred_username` in your third-party identity provider, you
can map it to Gemini Enterprise using the Workforce Identity Federation
attribute mapping (for example,
`attribute.as_user_identifier_1=assertion.preferred_username`).

The following examples show the required attribute mappings for common identity
providers. You can add more attribute mappings to support additional unique
identifiers, as described previously.

-
Entra ID with OIDC protocol

This example uses the email to uniquely identify users.

`google.subject=assertion.email.lowerAscii()
google.groups=assertion.groups
google.display_name=assertion.given_name
`

-
Entra ID with SAML protocol

This example uses the email to uniquely identify users.

소속 그룹이 많은 사용자(u02: 230개 그룹)에게서 403 오류와 '토큰에 groups 클레임 없음' 오류가 발생했습니다. Entra ID는 OIDC 토큰에 200개, SAML 토큰에 150개 그룹 제한이 있어 초과 시 그룹 클레임을 생략하며, 현재 WIF 매핑이 all_security_groups로 설정되어 있습니다. Entra 앱의 그룹 클레임을 '애플리케이션에 할당된 그룹'으로 제한해야 합니다.

2. 그룹 클레임(Groups claim) 설정을 '애플리케이션에 할당된 그룹(Groups assigned to the application)'으로 변경하고 저장한다
3. 영향받은 사용자(u02 등)가 재로그인하여 새 토큰으로 검색을 시도하도록 안내한다

### Core principle: No privilege escalation

A user interacting with Gemini Enterprise can only view and ground
responses on information that they are already authorized to access directly
in the source Google Workspace application. Gemini Enterprise never
bypasses source system access controls or grants additional permissions.

-
People from Google Workspace (Directory): User visibility in search
and grounding results respects your organization's Directory visibility
settings. For example, if a user's visibility in the Google Workspace
Directory is limited to their own department or organizational unit, they
are only able to find colleagues within that department using
Gemini Enterprise. They can't view profiles of employees in restricted
departments.

-
Google Groups: Content discovery and grounding adhere to group
membership and access settings. A user can only search and view content
from Google Groups that they are a member of and have permission to view.
Non-members can't discover or view discussions from private groups through
Gemini Enterprise.

[ge-sp-config#18] Microsoft SharePoint configuration - Users see "Need admin approval" when they connect (Gemini Enterprise 공식 문서, CC BY 4.0, 수집 기준일 2026-11-25)
### Users see "Need admin approval" when they connect

When users connect to Microsoft SharePoint from the Gemini Enterprise web
app for the first time, Microsoft might show a Need admin approval
screen. This happens if Gemini Enterprise requests administrator-level
permissions, or if your Microsoft Entra tenant prohibits users from authorizing
third-party apps without prior tenant-wide administrator consent.

To resolve this issue, an administrator must complete the first authorization.
After that, other users in your tenant can connect without the approval screen.

-
Ask a Microsoft Entra ID administrator who can grant tenant-wide consent to
sign in to the Gemini Enterprise web app and connect to
Microsoft SharePoint.

-
On the permissions screen, have the administrator select Consent on behalf
of your organization, and then click Accept.

-
Ask users to connect again.

For more information, see
Grant tenant-wide admin consent
in the Microsoft Entra documentation.

Note: Deleting and re-creating the data store doesn't resolve this issue,
because consent is granted in your Microsoft Entra tenant, not to the data store.

[ge-sp-config#12] Microsoft SharePoint configuration - Configure Microsoft API permissions (Gemini Enterprise 공식 문서, CC BY 4.0, 수집 기준일 2026-11-25)
-
Grant administrator consent. For information about how to grant consent, see
Grant tenant-wide administrator consent to an
application in the Microsoft Entra documentation.

Caution:

- Tenant-wide administrator consent (CRITICAL): You must grant tenant-wide administrator consent in Microsoft Entra ID for the registered application. Lack of administrator consent is a common failure point that prevents the connector from authenticating.

- Dual App IDs: Note that Gemini Enterprise uses different Microsoft Entra App IDs for different features. You need one App ID for the backend 'Data store' connection and a separate App ID to enable the 'Upload from OneDrive/SharePoint' button in the chat interface. Both applications require administrator consent.
